lifecycle_contract: One synchronous FIFO16 runtime and one PublishedArenaBackend are active at a time. The exact sequence fills 16 entries, repeats the newest target as a hit, compiles a seventeenth key to evict the oldest filler, invalidates the target backing between dispatch calls, dispatches different admitted bytes under an advanced backing version, confirms the subsequent hit, advances execution-context generation to flush/recompile, clears the cache, drops the runtime/arena, then creates a fresh arena and executes with a new context.
limitations: Backing invalidation is called directly between synchronous dispatcher invocations; this is not production owner notification or guest-write SMC.
STOP is not treated as an automatic cache clear; explicit clear and runtime drop are separate recorded steps.
No active-code SMC, guest memory fault, simultaneous arena, SMP, or independent concurrent runtime is exercised.
Recorded nanosecond values describe one bounded lifecycle schedule per process and make no performance or leak-free claim.
